ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Account__r.AccountStatus__c, "Lead") || ISPICKVAL(Account__r.AccountStatus__c, "Unpromoted") || ISPICKVAL(Account__r.AccountStatus__c, "Need Validation"), $Profile.Name = "Monster - Sales" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Create Opportunities is not allowed for accounts with the status 'Lead', 'Unpromoted', or 'Need Validation' when using the Monster - Sales Profile.
